purpose: Reusable author-side mechanism catalog. Labels are diagnostics, not solver prompt text.

mechanisms.label: Entity and ownership perimeter
mechanisms.root_cause: A retrieved figure is used for the wrong legal entity or ownership scope.
required_source_facts: Scope attached to each cash, debt, cost, or earnings figure
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Bind each input to its permitted entity before building the decision ledger.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Treat group cash as automatically available to every subsidiary.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Can reverse a funding or covenant conclusion.
fairness_checks: All relevant entity labels and restrictions must be visible
Do not require outside corporate-law assumptions
leakage_checks: Do not label files as the entity-confusion trap
Use comparable naming quality across entities

mechanisms.label: Period and effective-date alignment
mechanisms.root_cause: A date-valid fact is carried into the wrong reporting or operating window.
required_source_facts: Effective dates, expiry dates, and opening/closing balances
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Determine which facts govern each interval, then align the comparison.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Use a year-end facility limit for months before it becomes available.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes peak liquidity need or trend interpretation.
fairness_checks: State inclusion/exclusion conventions for boundary days when material
Supply any restatement or supersession rule
leakage_checks: Avoid filenames that reveal the governing document
Ensure no post-as-of answer information enters the solver pack

mechanisms.label: Metric, unit, and denominator selection
mechanisms.root_cause: Correct numbers are combined using incompatible definitions or scaling.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Choose comparable measures and convert only as the source permits.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Compare a percentage-point change with percentage growth, or use gross proceeds as net liquidity.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes coverage, sizing, or threshold classification.
fairness_checks: Necessary conversions must be derivable
Grading must recognize algebraically equivalent conventions
leakage_checks: Keep units equally legible for decisive and control inputs

mechanisms.label: Completeness-aware reconciliation
mechanisms.root_cause: A partial schedule is assumed exhaustive.
required_source_facts: Any disclosed omitted categories or bridge
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Separate a proven inconsistency from a reconciliation that lacks sufficient detail.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Declare fraud or an error because listed components do not equal a broader total.
fairness_checks: Permit an insufficiency finding when the pack cannot resolve the gap
Never hide a gold-critical component and still require its value
leakage_checks: Do not mark one schedule as suspicious
Include coherent clean controls

mechanisms.label: Cross-document reconciliation bridge
mechanisms.root_cause: Two valid financial measures are equated without their reconciling movements.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Identify the valid bridge and reconcile across documents.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Treat a retained-earnings movement as net income despite a disclosed distribution.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes earnings quality, available cash, or a modeled residual.
fairness_checks: Verify the bridge is complete
Do not copy oversimplified accounting identities as universal rules
leakage_checks: Hide neither movement nor governing definition
Do not force a particular worksheet sequence

mechanisms.label: Rounding and decision tolerance
mechanisms.root_cause: Display precision is mistaken for economic inconsistency or suppresses a decisive difference.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Assess whether the displayed discrepancy can arise under legitimate rounding.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Use an unusual decimal pattern as the evidence of error.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Avoids false alarms or wrong threshold calls.
fairness_checks: Choose tolerances from units and decision sensitivity
Check the answer remains identifiable after rendering
leakage_checks: Make mutated and control values share realistic precision
Inspect PDF/XLSX display and extracted values

mechanisms.label: Row grain and subtotal boundaries
mechanisms.root_cause: Headers, totals, or joint holdings are treated as ordinary independent observations.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Define the population before counting or aggregating.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Count a fund total as another investment or count a shared holding twice.
fairness_checks: Provide legible boundaries in the actual delivered modality
Allow different correct extraction methods
leakage_checks: Do not create difficulty solely by stripping indispensable formatting
Test a plain-value export for answer completeness

mechanisms.label: Filter, rank, then aggregate
mechanisms.root_cause: Individually correct operations are executed on the wrong subset or in the wrong order.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Determine the requested set and then compute its statistic.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Average all holdings before applying the size or eligibility filter.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes selected investments or reported portfolio performance.
fairness_checks: Resolve meaningful ties visibly
Supply enough rows to make every selected observation auditable
leakage_checks: Do not reveal a required implementation method in the prompt
Do not add irrelevant row volume purely as a time penalty

mechanisms.label: Rule activation, precedence, and exceptions
mechanisms.root_cause: A familiar financial rule is applied while a qualifying condition is ignored.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Select the operative clause before calculating.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Charge the usual rate even though a documented exception or threshold changes it.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes required payment, cost, drawability, or position size.
fairness_checks: Every branch must be specified or legitimately nonapplicable
Avoid ambiguous clause precedence
leakage_checks: Do not announce the exception as a trap
Retain realistic document hierarchy and discoverability

mechanisms.label: Answerability and source sufficiency
mechanisms.root_cause: A plausible answer is supplied despite irrelevant or unavailable evidence.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Decide which requested claims can actually be supported.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Fill missing case facts from general knowledge or a similarly named issuer.
fairness_checks: Use this only when acknowledging insufficiency is an acceptable deliverable
Do not grade undisclosed facts as mandatory
leakage_checks: Keep reference answers inaccessible
Validate degraded text still contains facts intended to remain answerable

mechanisms.label: Reconcile opposing evidence
mechanisms.root_cause: A persuasive narrative selects one side while ignoring a load-bearing contrary fact.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Explain how the evidence jointly supports a qualified decision.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: List pros and cons without resolving the decision-relevant conflict.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes conviction, recommended action, or conditions.
fairness_checks: Grade support and reasoning, not agreement with one analyst
Make the requested decision and necessary coverage public
leakage_checks: No hidden required themes unrelated to the public request
Allow valid alternative supported conclusions

mechanisms.label: Claim-to-source attribution
mechanisms.root_cause: A citation is present but does not support the associated entity, number, or causal claim.
required_source_facts: Distinction between facts and analyst inference
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Verify that each decision-bearing claim follows from the cited evidence.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Cite a peer's metric to support the subject company's forecast.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Exposes an apparently supported but invalid rationale.
fairness_checks: Score unsupported factual claims locally when possible
Do not require exact phrasing or ornamental citations
leakage_checks: References must not expose gold answers
Check citations resolve in the delivered pack

mechanisms.label: Live calculation and propagation
mechanisms.root_cause: A workbook matches the initial answer but is structurally wrong when an input changes.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Build linked calculations that preserve the specified relationships.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Hardcode a correct-looking output or omit a row from a calculation range.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Future scenarios produce false funding or valuation results.
fairness_checks: Demand dynamic behavior only where the task requests a reusable model
Verify formulas and recalculation in an available engine
leakage_checks: Test only disclosed input classes
Keep evaluator-only scenario values separate

mechanisms.label: Facts versus defensible judgment
mechanisms.root_cause: A grader confuses a different defensible assumption with an error, or accepts any answer under a wide band.
mechanisms.interpretive_step: Check unique facts exactly and assess judgment using explicit support and consistency.
mechanisms.plausible_wrong_reading: Match the reference price while using unsupported drivers, or reject a well-supported alternative.
mechanisms.decision_impact: Changes grading validity and the investment recommendation's credibility.
fairness_checks: Enumerate admissible interpretations instead of broad permissive grading
A numeric band alone cannot validate unsupported reasoning
leakage_checks: Do not expose reference assumptions unless intended as inputs
No hidden house view or privately expected recommendation
